name: Soft Hearted Drinks
source:
Comet Tab. What should have been a simple spectacle that passed over Earth turned into a world-changing event. Comet Tab split and its pieces crashed into soda factories across the country. When emergency workers arrived to see the damages, they found babies amidst the rubble. It turns out that whatever extraterrestrial properties the comet carried turned soda cans in the different factories into humans! Around that same time as well, you had your first taste of your favorite soda: Dr. Spice.

30 years later, you are determined to confess your love to the only man that your heart desires: Dr. Spice, one of the sodas who turned human all those years ago. Will you be able to win him over?

[From [url=https://husbandogoddess.itch.io/soft-hearted-drinks]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Tab彗星。本来只是一次掠过地球、供人观赏的天象，却成了改变世界的事件。Tab彗星解体，碎片落进全国各地的汽水工厂。救援人员赶到现场查看损失时，却在废墟中发现了婴儿。原来，彗星携带的某种外星物质，让各家工厂里的罐装汽水变成了人！差不多就在同一时期，你第一次尝到了后来最爱的汽水：香料博士。

30年后，你下定决心，要向心中唯一爱慕的男人告白：香料博士，正是当年从汽水变成人的其中一位。你能赢得他的心吗？
